```{r set-up-and-read-objects}

results_folder <- "output"
instructions <- createGiottoInstructions(save_plot = TRUE, show_plot = TRUE, return_plot = FALSE, save_dir = results_folder)
files <- list.files("halo_export/")
files <- paste0("halo_export/",files)
names(files) <- c("ctrl.1","tumor.4", "tumor.5","ctrl.2","tumor.7","tumor.6","tumor.8","ctrl.3","tumor.9","tumor.10","ctrl.4","ctrl.5", "tumor.1","tumor.2","tumor.3")

cleanHALO <- function(halo.obj, label=paste0(sample(letters, 5, T), collapse = ""))
{  # load in a halo object, make a unique column via a random string of 5 letters if no label supplied
  # halo.obj <- inputFile
  expr <- data.frame();   metadata <- data.table(); locations <- data.table()
  setnames(halo.obj, names(halo.obj), gsub(" ", ".", names(halo.obj)))
  cellIntensity <- grep("Cell.Intensity", names(halo.obj), value=T)
  expr <- halo.obj[, which(colnames(halo.obj) %in% cellIntensity)]  # save the Cell.Intensity columns as expression
  names(expr) <- gsub("\\.Cell.Intensity$","",names(expr))  # remove the words ".Cell.Intensity" from columns
  rownames(expr) <- paste0(label, "_", halo.obj$Object.Id)
  locations$x <- rowMeans(halo.obj[,c('XMax', 'XMin')]);   locations$y <- rowMeans(halo.obj[,c('YMax', 'YMin')])
  
  metadata <- halo.obj[, which(colnames(halo.obj) == 'Classifier.Label' | colnames(halo.obj) == 'Object.Id')] # recover region & cellID columns
  metadata$cellID <- paste0(label, "_", halo.obj$Object.Id)
  # metadata$STAT1.activity <- halo.obj$STAT1.Nucleus.Intensity/halo.obj$STAT1.Cell.Intensity
  # metadata$STAT3.activity <- halo.obj$STAT3.Nucleus.Intensity/halo.obj$STAT3.Cell.Intensity
  metadata$cellArea <- halo.obj$Cell.Area..µm..
  metadata$x <- locations$x;   metadata$y <- locations$y

  metadata[metadata == "NaN"] <- 0
  return(out <- list(expr = t(expr), metadata = metadata, locations = locations))
}

makeGiottoObject <- function(inputFile, label=sample.name)
{
  out <- cleanHALO(inputFile, label)
  print(paste0("Making the Giotto object for ", label))
  sln <- createGiottoObject(expression = out$expr,  spatial_locs = out$locations, instructions = instructions)
  print("Adding cell metadata"); # gc()  
  sln <- addCellMetadata(sln, new_metadata = out$metadata, by_column = TRUE, column_cell_ID = "cellID" )
  cell_metadata <- pDataDT(sln) # pull metadata out into new object
  
  #filter out undesirable cells
  keepID <- cell_metadata[Classifier.Label != "Background" & Classifier.Label != "Artifact", ]$cell_ID
  sln <- subsetGiotto(sln, cell_ids = keepID)
  
  #filter poor performing antibodies and cells without expression but will exclude on protein analysis for now
  # sln <- filterGiotto(gobject = sln, expression_threshold = 1, gene_det_in_min_cells = 10,
  #                            min_det_genes_per_cell = 2, expression_values = "raw", verbose = TRUE)
  print("Starting normalization")
  sln <- normalizeGiotto(gobject = sln, scalefactor = 6000, norm_methods = "standard",
                                verbose = TRUE, log_norm = FALSE, library_size_norm = FALSE,
                                scale_genes = FALSE, scale_cells = TRUE)
  print("Finished normalization")
  sln <- addStatistics(gobject = sln, expression_values = "normalized")
  return(sln)
}

# inputFile <- setDF(fread(files[1]))

out <- list()
for(i in 1:length(files))
{
  out[[i]] <- makeGiottoObject( inputFile = setDF(fread(files[i])), label = names(files)[i])
}

                                     214000,255000,300000,340000,380000,400000,450000), 
                         join_method = "shift", dry_run = F, verbose = TRUE)

```



```{r plot-ScreePlot}
# using channels that Sabrina used for downstream clustering
clusterChannels <- c("CD3E", "CD4", "CD8", "TCF1", "TOX", "CD45RO", "CD19", "CD20","HLA.DR", "CD38", "IGD", "CXCR5", 
                     "KI67", "CD45", "PAN.CYTO", "CD21", "MAC2/GAL3", "IFNG", "MART1", "GP100", "S100B")
sln <- runPCA(gobject = sln, expression_values = "normalized", scale_unit = TRUE, 
              method = "factominer", feats_to_use = clusterChannels)
signPCA(sln, scale_unit = TRUE, scree_ylim = c(0,40))
```


```{r plot-PCA}
Giotto::plotPCA(gobject = sln, point_shape = "no_border", point_size = 0.2)
```

Harmony integration
```{r harmony-integration}
sln = runGiottoHarmony(sln, vars_use = 'list_ID')
```

Calculate clusters by Leiden
```{r calculate-Clusters}
# sln <- createNearestNetwork(gobject = sln, dim_reduction_to_use = 'harmony', dim_reduction_name = 'harmony', 
#                             name = 'NN.harmony', dimensions_to_use = 1:10, k = 15)
# sln <- doLeidenClusterIgraph(gobject = sln, resolution = 0.1, n_iterations = 100, network_name = 'NN.harmony',
#                              name = 'leiden_harmony')

sln.sm <- subsetGiotto(gobject = sln, cell_ids = sample(sln$cell_ID, 1e5, replace=F)) # make a smaller dataset to work with 
sln.sm <- createNearestNetwork(gobject = sln.sm, dim_reduction_to_use = 'harmony', dim_reduction_name = 'harmony', 
                            name = 'NN.harmony', dimensions_to_use = 1:10, k = 10)  # calculate nearest neighbors, focus on global differences 
sln.sm <- doLeidenClusterIgraph(gobject = sln.sm, resolution = 0.3, n_iterations = 100, 
                                network_name = 'NN.harmony', name = 'leiden_harmony')  # make the clusters
sln <- labelTransfer(x = sln, y = sln.sm, labels = "leiden_harmony")  # assign cluster labels in the full dataset based on the reduced data
```

UMAP projection
```{r UMAP-projection}
sln <- runUMAPprojection(sln, random_subset = 1e5)  # project UMAP coordinates to the full dataset based on a subsampling
```

Plot all of the integrated tissues horizontally
```{r plot-tissues-horizontally, fig.width=20, fig.height=15}
md <- pDataDT(sln)
leiden_colors <- getDistinctColors(length(unique(md$trnsfr_leiden_harmony)))
names(leiden_colors) <- unique(md$trnsfr_leiden_harmony)
spatPlot(gobject = sln, cell_color = "trnsfr_leiden_harmony", point_shape = "no_border", point_size = 0.1, 
         cell_color_code = leiden_colors, coord_fix_ratio = 1, label_size = 2)
```


UMAP plot of all the cells 
```{r plot-UMAP}
plotUMAP(gobject = sln, dim_reduction_name = 'umap.projection', cell_color = 'trnsfr_leiden_harmony',
         cell_color_code = leiden_colors, show_NN_network = F, point_size = 0.5, point_shape="no_border",
         point_alpha=0.5)
```

Plot the umap with a contour overlay
```{r plot-UMAP-customContour}
data <- as.data.frame( sln@dimension_reduction$cells$cell$rna$umap$umap.projection@coordinates)
data$cluster <- sln@cell_metadata$cell$rna$trnsfr_leiden_harmony
leiden_colors <- getDistinctColors(length(unique(data$cluster)))
names(leiden_colors) <- unique(data$cluster)
data <- data[sample(1:nrow(data),3e5), ]
ggplot(data) + geom_point(aes(x=Dim.1, y=Dim.2, color=cluster), show.legend = FALSE, alpha=0.2, size=0.2) + 
  geom_point(aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, color = cluster), size = 3, show.legend = TRUE) + 
  geom_density2d(aes(x=Dim.1, y=Dim.2), linewidth=0.25, color="black") + theme_classic()  + scale_color_manual(values = leiden_colors)   + 
  scale_x_continuous(limits=c(min(data$Dim.1) - .10*diff(range(data$Dim.1)),max(data$Dim.1) + .10* diff(range(data$Dim.1)))) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(min(data$Dim.2) - .10*diff(range(data$Dim.2)),max(data$Dim.2) + .10* diff(range(data$Dim.2)))) + 
  ggtitle("All cells - downsampled") +  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 16)))
rm(data) 
```
